### `account.rename`

- **Capabilities:** CAP-ACCT-RENAME
- **Kind of edit:** many
- **Old endpoint:** PUT /api/accounts/{name} with new_name
- **Edits:** replace_token; delete_meta; insert_meta; replace
- **Files:** every file of the set with a reference to the account
- **Intended change:** A and every subaccount `A:…` become B and `B:…` (ADR-0049 amendment): every account token naming one of them (postings, `open`, `close`, `balance`, `pad` both accounts, `note`, `document`, account-typed `custom` values), and every metadata value on any entry and every `custom` string value that is exactly one of those account names; text that merely contains a name is untouched. Nothing else changes. No renamed name may already exist (that is a merge)
- **Metadata written:** —
- **May ask to acknowledge:** —
- **Refused when:** a target name already exists (use account.merge); a target name breaks the account grammar; an encrypted file references a renamed account (not editable, ADR-0009)
- **v0.3 oracle expectation:** I10; I2 (glob includes); I3 (plugins)
- **Status:** decided
- **Milestone:** M4
- **ADRs:** ADR-0049; ADR-0009

### `account.merge`

- **Capabilities:** CAP-ACCT-MERGE
- **Kind of edit:** many
- **Old endpoint:** n/a
- **Edits:** replace_token; delete
- **Files:** every file of the set with a posting, `note`, `document`, `pad` or `balance` naming A
- **Intended change:** move_postings(A → B): every posting of A, A's `note` and `document` directives, and every `pad` whose source is A re-pointed to B; a transaction with legs on both keeps two B postings; A's own `balance` and `pad` directives and A's `custom "budget"` directives dropped (listed in the preview); A's `open` and `close` stay, leaving an empty A (ADR-0049 and its amendment)
- **Metadata written:** —
- **May ask to acknowledge:** BalanceError on a `balance` assertion of B that newly fails (listed in the preview)
- **Refused when:** B is not open over the whole date span of A's postings; B's currency constraints reject a moved posting; holdings at cost and A and B book differently (warning plus refusal until confirmed); A has subaccounts (ADR-0049)
- **v0.3 oracle expectation:** none: no old endpoint
- **Status:** decided
- **Milestone:** M4
- **ADRs:** ADR-0049; ADR-0009

### `account.delete-with-transactions`

- **Capabilities:** CAP-ACCT-DELETE
- **Kind of edit:** many
- **Old endpoint:** DELETE /api/accounts/{name} (delete_transactions=true, the default)
- **Edits:** delete
- **Files:** every file of the set with an entry touching A
- **Intended change:** every transaction with a leg on A removed (every leg), every `pad` whose source is A removed, and all of A's directives removed: `open`, `close`, `balance`, `pad`, `note`, `document`, `custom "budget"`. An account with no transactions is the same intent with no transactions
- **Metadata written:** —
- **May ask to acknowledge:** BalanceError on a `balance` assertion of another account whose balance changes, including accounts padded from A (each listed in the all-time preview)
- **Refused when:** A has subaccounts (ADR-0049); the user has not chosen between Move and Delete (the question has no default)
- **v0.3 oracle expectation:** I10; I2 (glob includes); I3 (plugins); FIX-I1 (legacy keeps A's balance, pad, note and budget directives); FIX-I11 (legacy lets the new errors through)
- **Status:** decided
- **Milestone:** M4
- **ADRs:** ADR-0049; ADR-0008

### `txn.edit`

- **Capabilities:** CAP-TXN-INLINE-EDIT; CAP-TXN-SAVE; CAP-TXN-METADATA
- **Kind of edit:** change-one
- **Old endpoint:** PUT /api/ledger/transactions (one transaction)
- **Edits:** replace
- **Files:** the file holding the targeted entry
- **Intended change:** the entry addressed by (TransactionId, entry_hash) replaced by the request merged against the parsed source entry: `@@`, lot dates and labels, elided amounts and metadata types kept where the user did not change them; nothing else changes
- **Metadata written:** memo; document*; note; user keys typed in the drawer
- **May ask to acknowledge:** BalanceError on a `balance` assertion of an account whose postings changed (amount, date or account)
- **Refused when:** entry_hash mismatch (the entry changed since it was read); the entry is plugin-generated or in an encrypted file; the edit does not balance or leaves an inactive account (ValidationError); a booking error on a reduction (BookingError, ReductionError, AmbiguousMatchError): never acknowledgeable; the edit removes or changes a read-forever identity key (`id`, `transaction_id`, `import-key`, `external_id`, `external_id_type`, `ofx_id`, `source_account`): only the consented cleanup may (INV-21 c, INV-14)
- **v0.3 oracle expectation:** I10; I2 (glob includes); I3 (plugins); FIX-L3-02 (legacy refuses priced and cost edits; drops lot dates and labels); FIX-L3-05 (legacy rewrites the written scale); FIX-L3-15 (legacy stringifies typed metadata); M28; non-comparable: entries without a legacy `id`
- **Status:** decided
- **Milestone:** M5
- **ADRs:** ADR-0009; ADR-0026; ADR-0008

- **ADRs:** ADR-0009; ADR-0026

- **Kind of edit:** many

- **Milestone:** M6
- **ADRs:** ADR-0027; ADR-0026; ADR-0009

### `data.undo`

- **Capabilities:** CAP-DATA-UNDO; CAP-TXN-OPLOG
- **Kind of edit:** many
- **Old endpoint:** n/a
- **Edits:** insert; replace; delete
- **Files:** the files the undone write touched
- **Intended change:** the inverse of one journaled write: each entry the write produced (found by its canonical text) removed, and each entry it removed or replaced restored at the file and position the undo journal recorded (the journal stores canonical text plus location; review:28 §4.1 identity condition 4); nothing else. Writes of option lines, meta lines and whole files (doc.documents-option, settings.*, import.link-element, ws.*) are not undoable this way and say so
- **Metadata written:** —
- **May ask to acknowledge:** as the undone write's row
- **Refused when:** an entry the write produced is gone or changed since (located by canonical hash; never guessed); a later write touched the same entries (undo the later one first); the recorded position no longer exists (the file changed around it): the restore is offered as a routed insert with a preview instead
- **v0.3 oracle expectation:** none: no old endpoint
- **Status:** draft
- **Milestone:** M5
- **ADRs:** ADR-0026; ADR-0008

### `ws.adopt-legacy`

- **Capabilities:** CAP-LEGACY-ADOPT
- **Kind of edit:** many
- **Old endpoint:** n/a
- **Edits:** new_file; option_line
- **Files:** the new workspace folder only (INV-26: nothing under the legacy root is written)
- **Intended change:** the legacy ledger set copied into the new workspace and its documents into `<folder>/documents/` (Copy, the only mode, ADR-0020, ADR-0062); an `option "documents"` naming a legacy path is the one line rewritten, to the copied folder; sources read while holding the legacy lock of every legacy install whose config names them, each taken by one non-blocking try; a lock file absent at the try must still be absent, and the sources unchanged, after the read (ADR-0062); the copy loads the same as the source; the legacy files are only read
- **Metadata written:** —
- **May ask to acknowledge:** —
- **Refused when:** any write under the legacy root (INV-26); the destination exists; an include that resolves outside the legacy root's folder; a legacy lock is held, or its try fails in any other way (fail closed): "Quit the old Finzytrack first", never waited for (ADR-0062); a lock file absent at the try appeared, or a source changed, during the read; the copy does not load the same as the source
- **v0.3 oracle expectation:** none: no old endpoint
- **Status:** draft
- **Milestone:** M3
- **ADRs:** ADR-0020; ADR-0017; ADR-0062

## Legacy mutators

| v0.3 `LedgerManager` method | v0.4 row(s) |
|---|---|
| `append_entries` | import.commit; inv.add-holding; inv.buy; inv.reinvest; inv.dividend; inv.sell; inv.conversion; inv.cd-maturity; inv.interest |
| `write_price_directives` | price.write |
| `edit_price_directives` | price.edit |
| `open_deposit` | inv.open-deposit |
| `import_statement` | not built: ADR-0030 (statement import is cut; one-upload sync replaces it) |
| `undo_statement_import` | not built: ADR-0030 (its undo goes with it; D1 undo journal covers v0.4 writes) |
| `create_account_directive` | account.create |
| `update_account_directive` | account.edit; account.rename |
| `close_account_directive` | account.close |
| `reopen_account_directive` | account.reopen |
| `delete_account_directive` | account.delete-with-transactions |
| `delete_account` | account.delete-with-transactions; not built: ADR-0049 (delete_transactions=false removed the account but left its postings, a broken ledger; v0.4 offers reassign instead) |
| `create_budget_directive` | budget.create |
| `update_budget_directive` | budget.edit |
| `delete_budget_directive` | budget.delete |
| `upsert_commodity_metadata` | inv.commodity-metadata |
| `set_operating_currencies` | settings.operating-currencies |
| `create_document_attachment` | doc.account-attach |
| `delete_document_directive` | doc.account-detach |
| `ensure_documents_option` | doc.documents-option |
| `update_transactions_by_id` | txn.edit; txn.bulk-edit |
| `delete_transactions_by_id` | txn.delete |
| `delete_transactions_for_account` | account.delete-with-transactions |
| `add_balance_directive` | balance.add |
| `update_balance_directive` | balance.edit |
| `delete_balance_directive` | balance.delete |
